title: Context compaction runtime event payload (v0.2 mechanical summary)
description: P0-D S3 (2026-08-14, ADR-0010 v1.10 / CONTEXT_COMPACTION_DESIGN §4): the five-section template summary replaces the A6 whole-round drop as the primary compaction mechanism. 2026-08-18 B 定案 (ADR-0010 §14.29): compaction is now fully MECHANICAL — the producer emits mode "mechanical" and makes ZERO model calls; the two LLM slots (注意事项/后续衔接) are fixed placeholders until the HA structured-fact aggregation phase lands. "template_summary" remains a valid value for historical journal replay. All v0.1 counters stay; the v0.2 fields describe the trigger (rhythm 160K / fallback 200K / session_end), the archive pointer (id/digest/path), completeness (summary_incomplete is always false for the mechanical producer), the retained recent tail, guard-retry force (guard_failed) and archive write outcome (archive_write_failed). 2026-08-14 review fix: cooldown is 2 model rounds; guard failures retry up to 3 times then force one compaction and report guard_failed; the session-end compaction pins the marker into the sidecar.

trigger_tokens.description: Measured prompt tokens of the previous (collapsed) model round — the value that crossed the trigger. v7 (S1 修订批): the model_summary path reports the ACTUAL-context estimate (全量会话估算 chars/2) instead, because the semantic track is triggered by the model's own summary block (model_selected) or the actual-context 900K window (context_scale_window), not by a prompt-token crossing.

target_tokens.description: Kept-conversation estimate after the summary (marker + preamble + recent tail).

rounds_since_last_compaction.description: Model rounds since the previous summary (the 2-round cooldown per ADR-0010 v1.14, measured before this summary).

rounds_dropped.description: Complete tool rounds removed by the summary (each round = one assistant declaration plus its tool replies and injected pushes).

messages_kept.description: Messages remaining after the summary plus the injected marker.

estimated_tokens_after.description: Estimated kept-conversation tokens (chars/2 — conservative CJK-aware estimate).

mode.description: Compactation carrier. "mechanical" = the structured track (2026-08-18 B 定案: zero model calls — tools/commands/results are pointer-ized and drained, ADR-0010 §14.29). "template_summary" = historical journals only. "model_summary" = v7 semantic track (动态上下文滑块 S1 修订批, 2026-09-15, 设计 §3.4.1 DP-14/DP-17): the model produced a structured semantic summary block ([SEMANTIC_SUMMARY …]) and it replaced the region outside the slider; the mechanical track still drained the structured content.

reason.description: Trigger class: rhythm = measured tokens crossed the H+buffer ordinary trigger with the 2-round cooldown met（动态上下文滑块 S1 起：H＝滑窗上限、缓冲默认 32K ⇒ 保守档 192K；滑块把视图压在上限内 ⇒ 该线退化为「驱逐停滞兜底」）; fallback = the view-scale window guard (safety_tokens) bypassed the cooldown（S1 起常态不可达，保留为 S2 展开膨胀时的视图面兜底）; context_scale = the ACTUAL-context hard guard (全量会话估算 ≥ ORZ_CONTEXT_SCALE_HARD_TOKENS，默认 950K，实际上下文刻度) forced one compaction — **also covers the fail-soft degradation** when the compression-window upload would exceed ORZ_CONTEXT_SCALE_WINDOW_CAP_TOKENS（默认 1.10M；审查修正批 2026-09-15）：窗口**不开**，同迭代改走机械强制压缩，事实经 `mechanical_audit_update{key=context_scale:<档位>}` 的 `anomaly=window_upload_over_cap` 如实落账（用户 2026-09-15 裁定：950K 档压不下线时改走「**硬截留＋明确告知**」——滑块之外清零并注入「上一轮上下文压缩失败，已机械截留」，事实记 `mechanical_audit_update{key=context_scale:hard_950k_intercepted}` 的 `anomaly=hard_context_compaction_failed_*`，该档不再强制开窗）; context_scale_window = the model-participated compression window closed (最高刻度 900K 提醒开窗后 ≤3 轮) — with mode model_summary the model's semantic summary replaced the region, with mode mechanical the fallback compaction ran（S1 前该路径写作 `attention_920k_window`——不在闭枚举内，属契约漂移，S1 批按契约同步）; model_selected = the model emitted a [SEMANTIC_SUMMARY] block OUTSIDE a window（500K 纯提醒后的自选压缩，v7 DP-14）; session_end = the end-of-session compaction that pins the summary into the sidecar before write-back.

guard_failed.description: Reduction-guard retry exhausted: the guard was evaluated but not satisfiable on three consecutive trigger rounds, so one compaction was forced without the guard (2026-08-14 review fix). Absent/omitted on older v0.2 payloads; the producer always writes it (false unless forced).

archive_write_failed.description: The summary archive could not be persisted after the bounded write retries — the marker and event still carry the intended path/digest, and the failure is explicitly surfaced (2026-08-14 review fix). Absent/omitted on older v0.2 payloads; the producer always writes it (false unless a write retry loop failed).

summary_id.description: Archive id under .gsa/compaction/ (null when the summary failed and no archive was written).

summary_digest.description: sha256 of the archive markdown (null when no archive was written).

summary_path.description: Archive file path (null when no archive was written).

summary_incomplete.description: Completeness flag — always false for the mechanical producer (2026-08-18 B 定案, ADR-0010 §14.29): compaction makes zero model calls, so there is no LLM-slot failure path. Historical template_summary journals may carry true (the retired termination state: the LLM slots failed validation after ≤3 attempts and only the mechanical slots were kept).

retained_rounds.description: Recent tail rounds configured for verbatim retention after the summary (2 normally). The retired termination state widened it by 1 — historical template_summary journals only (2026-08-18 B 定案 removed the widening along with the LLM slots). 审查修正批 (2026-09-15): on the **model_summary** path the retention boundary is the slider resident band, not the drain tail — the producer reports the number of complete rounds still present in `messages` after the replacement (the mechanical path keeps reporting the configured tail).
